scope: native Newton FR3 v2 articulation, effort-mode compliant control, simulated pushes; no hardware, no contact sensor, no safety certification
wrench_estimate_note: supervisor uses the injected wrench (simulation ground truth); the acceleration-based inverse-dynamics estimate is logged beside it in each steady_deflection subrow for comparison
measurement_notes: Steady deflection is the mean over the last 0.5 s of a 1.5 s hold; expected |delta| = F / K_lin with K_lin from PROFILES[profile].

A fixed 0.2 Nm*sign(dq) Coulomb feed-forward was measured to be invalid (effective stiction 0.05-0.6 Nm, configuration-dependent and mixed sign). It was removed. Residual-wrench compensation F_corr = g*(F_imp + f_ext) (g=4), a runbook-A5 'injected wrench + controller estimate' feedback, drives the steady-state bias to zero without identifying the plant.
The supervisor's soft speed limiter is reinforced on every RETURN / released-YIELD tick through J[:3].T using the joint-torque budget; the Cartesian F_lin_max cap otherwise limited its deceleration.

The first A5 run's 334 'return_speed' violations were a harness bookkeeping error: the 'free' test read the NEXT wrench segment rather than the one applied. The applied wrench is now captured before tick().

EE error during an elbow push is F_task/K_lin; even at K_lin=500 N/m (grasp, the stiffest allowed PROFILES entry) a 10 N flange-equivalent push yields ~20 mm, so the spec's <=15 mm bound cannot hold for a generic link-4/link-6 push at these forces. Measured, not relaxed.

The null-space PD now uses the dynamically consistent projector N = I - J^T (M^-1 J^T (J M^-1 J^T)^-1)^T from Newton's inverse-dynamics mass matrix M(q) (J M^-1 N ~ 0, N^2 ~ N), k_null=15 Nm/rad with critical damping. M is measured every tick; its min/max eigenvalues are in mass_matrix_eigenvalues (SPD claim measured, not asserted).

kinematic_box_hand.note: scripted kinematic box pushed along -x into link7; peak from the model-based external wrench estimate (M qdd + C + g - tau), not a contact sensor; Newton's rigid_contact_force readout stayed at 0 N in this venv

not_done: elbow_push <=15 mm at 10 N: if still F_task/K, the pre-registered bound may be unreachable at the allowed stiffness; row stays FAIL until the user approves a change (rule 6)
